measurements.notes: Composite: gas pipeline not found km, GHI 4.27 kWh/m2/day (35% weight). Wind and land-for-generation components not yet implemented — index is therefore conservative. Solar/wind cannot firm a data center load; counted here only for a hybrid or bridging strategy.
Design wet-bulb (0.4% exceedance) 25.6 C; mean 11.7 C. Computed from 10 yr of ERA5 hourly reanalysis via Stull (2011).

Distance only — treated flow capacity must be confirmed with the operator. Reclaimed water is usually the highest score-per-dollar water intervention available: it neutralizes most community opposition and is often cheaper than potable.
6991 h/yr below 24.0 C. Design dry-bulb 35.1 C. Indicative PUE 1.145 — a screening proxy, not a CFD-grade model.

MODELED, NOT PROJECTED: linear extrapolation of the observed 30-year trend in annual design-day temperature (+0.062 C/yr). This is a placeholder for NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 and should not be cited as a climate projection.

Outside mapped FEMA flood hazard areas. Note that NFHL does not model pluvial (flash) flooding, which no widely-available dataset captures well — this is a known blind spot, not a clean bill of health.
mapzen DEM, 5x5 grid over 2.0 km. Mean slope 0.8%, p90 1.5%, relief 25 m. Below 2% is essentially free; earthwork cost rises roughly quadratically above that for a large flat-pad campus.

SCREENING ESTIMATE ONLY. exurban / village (108 buildings/km2) within 5.0 km; assumed 33% developable. This is an upper bound on physically developable land and a much looser upper bound on ACQUIRABLE land — parcel fragmentation typically cuts it by half or more. Confirm against cadastral data before any decision.

measurements.notes: Nearest interconnection facility 'Pixel Factory Data Center' at 7.9 km; 7 facilities within 100 km. Weight this near zero for a training campus — over-weighting it biases site selection toward expensive metro land.
38 network presences across 6 facilities within 50 km. Network presences at carrier-neutral facilities are a proxy for carrier availability, not a direct count of carriers able to serve this parcel.
INFERRED, NOT MEASURED: no fiber routes mapped; distance is to the nearest telecom exchange or data center, used as a proxy for route presence. Tier D.

0 estimated dwellings from 0 OSM residential features within 1.0 km. Apartment blocks estimated at 4 units/level. Noise from chillers and generator testing is the most common specific complaint in data center opposition — distance is the cheapest mitigation. Zero count may reflect sparse OSM building coverage rather than genuinely empty land; tier lowered to C.
Read together with lnd.heavy_haul_access: a nearby port is worthless if the final approach cannot carry a 300-tonne transformer. OSM port tagging is inconsistent; treat as screening-grade.

measurements.notes: Hanover County Board of Supervisors approved the 1,200-acre Tract rezoning UNANIMOUSLY on 27 Mar 2024, after a unanimous Planning Commission recommendation in January. A unanimous vote is the strongest available signal of local political appetite.

Required discretionary rezoning, which carries political risk in principle — but it passed unanimously at both commission and board, so the pathway was routine in practice for this jurisdiction at that time.

Actual transaction: $33M for 1,200 acres (May 2024) = ~$27,500/ha. This is a real arms-length sale price post-entitlement, not a comparable — unusually good evidence for this factor, though still Tier C since it was read from press coverage rather than a parsed deed record.

US domestic deployment. Advanced accelerators may be installed and operated at a US site without export licensing; the controls govern export and re-export, not domestic use. Rule set checked 2026-09-03 — this is the fastest-moving input in the framework and must be re-verified per analysis.

gates.name: Credible power path to target load
gates.reason: Substation available capacity is unknown — the most common cause of late-stage project failure. Verify with the utility before committing capital.
gates.remediation_hint: Evaluate behind-the-meter generation, or shift target year, or reduce target load.

gates.name: Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture
gates.reason: Water availability and rights both unmeasured.
gates.remediation_hint: Switch to air-cooled or closed-loop (costs 10-30% more power), or secure reclaimed water.

gates.name: Flood exclusion
gates.reason: Outside the 500-year floodplain (modeled return period 1000 yr).
gates.remediation_hint: Site the pad outside the mapped zone, or commission a local flood study — global datasets are coarse.

gates.name: Sufficient contiguous developable land
gates.reason: 2592 ha contiguous developable area (computed upper bound).
gates.remediation_hint: Expand the AOI, consider adjacent parcel assembly, or re-profile to a smaller build.

gates.name: Entitlement path exists
gates.reason: Requires discretionary rezoning (rezoning_routine) — this converts an engineering problem into a political one.
gates.remediation_hint: Pre-application meeting with planning staff; budget 9-24 months and community engagement.

gates.name: Protected area exclusion
gates.remediation_hint: Reconfigure the site boundary to avoid overlap entirely — mitigation pathways are slow and uncertain.

gates.name: No active data center moratorium
gates.remediation_hint: Verify moratorium scope and expiry; some exempt by-right industrial zones or cap by megawatt.

gates.name: Intended compute is legally deployable
gates.remediation_hint: Re-profile to domestically-available accelerators, or evaluate license pathway with counsel.

hyperscale_training.headline: Not yet — and the reason is missing evidence, not a bad site. 6 knockout checks cannot be evaluated at all because the factor each one reads is unmeasured; only 33% of the decision weight is measured. Profitability in particular is unanswerable here: 4 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return. The verification queue is ordered by how much of the decision each answer settles.
hyperscale_training.profitability_basis: 4 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return.

blockers.title: Substation available capacity is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Load-serving study or written statement of available capacity at the named substation, for the named load, in the named year.

blockers.title: Interconnection queue time to energization is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Queue position and cluster study schedule for a comparable request
blockers.owner: ISO/RTO interconnection queue, then the utility

blockers.title: Baseline water stress is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 5 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Will-serve letter or withdrawal permit precedent

blockers.title: Water rights and withdrawal permitting is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 5 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Permit precedent for comparable industrial withdrawal in the same basin

blockers.title: Coastal flood and sea level rise exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 3 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Site-specific study; global rasters are screening-grade only

blockers.title: Protected area and habitat overlap is unmeasured, and Protected area exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 2 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Zoning determination letter and title/survey

blockers.title: Entitlement path exists
blockers.why: Requires discretionary rezoning (rezoning_routine) — this converts an engineering problem into a political one. The site is not disqualified, but the score is capped until this condition is resolved.
blockers.resolve: Pre-application meeting with planning staff; budget 9-24 months and community engagement.

blockers.title: Modeled 10-year TCO is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: 10-year TCO model built on the confirmed tariff, land price and scope

blockers.title: Construction labor availability is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Order-of-magnitude estimate against a real scope

blockers.title: Critical equipment lead time is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Quoted delivery windows for transformers, switchgear and generation

blockers.title: Permitting timeline is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Median approval duration for comparable applications, from the record

blockers.title: Environmental review burden is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 6 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Written opinion on approval pathway and timeline

blockers.title: Tax incentive package is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 6 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Statute or code section plus the qualification test the project must meet

blockers.title: Industrial retail power price is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 6 points, against a ± band of 16.
blockers.resolve: Delivered all-in $/MWh for the tariff the project would actually take
blockers.owner: Utility rate desk or wholesale market data provider

inference_edge.headline: Not yet — and the reason is missing evidence, not a bad site. 6 knockout checks cannot be evaluated at all because the factor each one reads is unmeasured; only 34% of the decision weight is measured. Profitability in particular is unanswerable here: 4 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return. The verification queue is ordered by how much of the decision each answer settles.
inference_edge.profitability_basis: 4 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return.
